permissions.title: Permissões Necessárias
permissions.description: Mouthy needs one permission to read your selected text.

accessibility.title: Acesso à Acessibilidade
accessibility.description: Required to copy the text you select so Mouthy can read it aloud.

errors.checkFailed: Erro ao verificar permissões. Por favor, tente novamente.
errors.requestFailed: Erro ao solicitar permissão. Por favor, tente novamente.

shortcut.title: Atalhos do Mouthy
shortcut.description: Configure the keyboard shortcuts that read your selection or clipboard aloud

speak.name: Speak Selection
speak.description: Reads the selected text aloud. Press again to stop.

speak_clipboard.name: Speak Clipboard
speak_clipboard.description: Reads the text you copied aloud. Press again to stop.

errors.reset: Falha ao redefinir atalho para o valor original

backend.title: Speech Engine
backend.description: Local (offline) runs the Kokoro voice on this Mac, from files you download on the Models page. HTTP server sends the selected text to the server URL below.

backendUrl.title: Server URL
backendUrl.description: Address of the OpenAI-compatible speech server, such as Kokoro-FastAPI. Selected text is sent to it; plain http is unencrypted. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8880

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Pick a voice, preview it, or blend it with a second one. Offline voices download from the list or the Models page; with the HTTP server, the list is the server's.
voice.serverSlow: The server has not answered in 10 seconds.
voice.serverUnreachable: Could not get the server's voices: {{error}}
voice.serverEmpty: The server lists no voices. Type one under Other.
voice.noneInstalled: No voice is downloaded yet. Download one below, or manage files on the Models page.
voice.modelMissing: The offline model is not downloaded yet, so voices cannot speak or preview.

installedOnly.title: Installed only
installedOnly.description: Show only the voices downloaded to this Mac.

voice.englishOnly: Reads English text only, with this language's accent.

other.title: Other voice or blend
other.description: Any voice id the list lacks, or a blend such as bm_lewis(70)+bm_george(30).

blend.title: Blend
blend.description: Mix the voice in use with a second voice; the slider sets each one's share.
blend.none: No other voice to blend with
blend.accent: Blends read with the first voice's accent.

espeak.title: Pronounce unknown words with espeak-ng
espeak.description: Names and other words the built-in dictionary lacks are read by espeak-ng instead of spelled out letter by letter. espeak-ng is GPL-3 software you install yourself (brew install espeak-ng); Mouthy runs it as a separate program and does not bundle it. Each new unknown word can delay speech by up to half a second.
espeak.notFound: espeak-ng is not installed. Install it with: brew install espeak-ng

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How fast the voice speaks, from 0.5× to 2×.

outputDevice.title: Dispositivo de Saída
outputDevice.description: Select the audio device that plays speech

status.title: Status
status.server: Mouthy is using the HTTP server. These files are used when Speech Engine is Local (offline).
status.unlistedVoice: Voice {{voice}} has no file here: pick one below, or type a listed voice in General.
status.failed: The offline voice did not load: {{error}}
status.ready: Ready to speak offline with the {{model}} model and the {{voice}} voice.

model.title: Model
model.description: Mouthy uses one model at a time. int8 is the smallest and fastest; fp32 is the original, full-precision model.
model.fp32: Full precision: about twice as slow as int8, uses the most memory

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: Mouthy reads all text as English, with British pronunciation for British voices and American for the rest. Voices for other languages cannot read their own language.

folder.title: Models Folder
folder.description: Where the downloaded files are kept.

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: Kokoro-82M by hexgrad, converted to ONNX by onnx-community and downloaded from Hugging Face, is released under the Apache License 2.0.

experimentalToggle.label: Recursos Experimentais
experimentalToggle.description: Ativar recursos experimentais que ainda estão em desenvolvimento.

startHidden.label: Iniciar Oculto
startHidden.description: Iniciar na bandeja do sistema sem abrir a janela.

autostart.label: Iniciar na Inicialização
autostart.description: Iniciar automaticamente o Mouthy quando você fizer login no seu computador.

showTrayIcon.label: Mostrar ícone na bandeja
showTrayIcon.description: Exibir o ícone do Mouthy na bandeja do sistema.

style.title: Sobreposição
style.description: Choose the overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill. On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Posição da Sobreposição
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen while Mouthy is speaking.

logDirectory.title: Diretório de Logs
logDirectory.description: Local onde os arquivos de log são armazenados

liveLogs.title: Logs ao Vivo
liveLogs.description: Transmita os logs do aplicativo em tempo real para diagnosticar problemas sem abrir o arquivo de log. Apenas os logs emitidos enquanto este painel estiver aberto são exibidos; respeita a configuração de Nível de Log acima.
liveLogs.empty: Aguardando logs… As entradas aparecem aqui à medida que o app as emite.

keyboardImplementation.title: Implementação do Teclado
keyboardImplementation.description: Escolha o sistema responsável pelos atalhos de teclado.
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Os atalhos de teclado eram incompatíveis e foram redefinidos para os padrões
keyboardImplementation.bindingsUnbound: Some keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and are now unset, because another shortcut uses their default keys

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Diagnóstico do teclado
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Verifica se os eventos de teclado chegam ao Mouthy. Apenas a contagem de eventos é registrada — nunca quais teclas você pressiona.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Ouvindo… pressione seu atalho algumas vezes (ex.: Option+Escape)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: O Secure Input está bloqueando os eventos de tecla — atalhos que incluem uma tecla normal não funcionam até que isso seja resolvido.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Chegaram eventos de modificadores, mas nenhum evento de tecla — algo está suprimindo as teclas mesmo com o Secure Input indicando desativado. Por favor, relate isso no GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Os eventos de tecla estão chegando normalmente ao Mouthy.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: Nenhum evento capturado — você pressionou alguma tecla durante o teste?

onboardingPreview.title: Pré-visualizar configuração inicial
onboardingPreview.description: Preview onboarding screens without changing permissions or completion state

appDataDirectory.title: Diretório de Dados do App
appDataDirectory.description: Local onde o Mouthy armazena seus dados

thirdPartyNotices.title: Third-party licences
thirdPartyNotices.description: Licences of the software Mouthy includes

handy.title: Handy
handy.description: The open-source speech-to-text app Mouthy is forked from
handy.details: Mouthy is derived from Handy by CJ Pais (MIT). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Handy project.

kokoro.title: Kokoro
kokoro.details: Mouthy's default voice, af_alloy, comes from Kokoro-82M by hexgrad (Apache-2.0), which runs inside Mouthy or through Kokoro-FastAPI.

rodio.title: rodio
rodio.details: Mouthy plays speech through rodio and cpal from the RustAudio project.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Mouthy needs accessibility permissions to copy the text you select.

appLanguage.title: Idioma da Aplicação
appLanguage.description: Alterar o idioma da interface do Mouthy

theme.title: Tema do aplicativo
theme.description: Escolha se o Mouthy segue o tema do sistema ou permanece claro ou escuro

overlay.clipboardSecret: Clipboard holds a secret and was not read

secureInput.blockedNoCulprit_one: O macOS está bloqueando temporariamente 1 atalho
secureInput.blockedNoCulprit_other: O macOS está bloqueando temporariamente {{count}} atalhos
secureInput.recorderBlockedWithCulprit: {{name}} pode estar bloqueando alterações nos atalhos
secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: O macOS está bloqueando temporariamente alterações nos atalhos
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Não é possível gravar atalhos agora — o Secure Input do macOS está bloqueando os eventos de tecla. Resolva primeiro o aviso do Secure Input.
